title: CHAPTER 027 - v3.6 terminal-state validation suite fixed
description: Complete automated validation chapter for active Runner v3.6. Verifies live runtime identity and exact candidate hash, backs up runner/state/log, parses source AST, proves Save-State and lastTerminalStatus are present, validates terminal handling markers for SUCCESS/FAILED_*/REJECTED, performs isolated JSON state round-trips for SUCCESS, FAILED_SCRIPT, FAILED_TEST and REJECTED without touching production state, and arms a delayed post-finalize verifier that confirms task 027 is persisted and not retried. Fixes only the Chapter 026 report-array construction bug.
backup: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root='C:/3EN-Agent'; $stamp=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $bk=$root+'/backups/027/'+$stamp; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $bk|Out-Null; foreach($name in @('3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1','3en-agent.state.json','3en-agent.log')){$src=$root+'/'+$name;if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $src){Copy-Item -LiteralPath $src -Destination ($bk+'/'+$name) -Force}}; Write-Host ('BACKUP_ROOT='+$bk); Write-Host 'CHAPTER_027_BACKUP=PASS'
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root='C:/3EN-Agent'; $runner=$root+'/3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1'; $expected='57233841FF0F7F6BF78E5EBEB77D0ECCDC2EA07634A81595F31E88B85E8B4B54'; $report=$root+'/chapter-027-v36-validation.txt'; Set-Content -LiteralPath $report -Encoding UTF8 -Value '=== CHAPTER 027 V3.6 TERMINAL-STATE VALIDATION ==='; Write-Host '=== READ / EVIDENCE ==='; $self=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ('ProcessId='+$PID) -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host ('CURRENT_PID='+$PID); Write-Host ('CURRENT_COMMANDLINE='+$self.CommandLine); if($self.CommandLine -notlike '*3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1*'){throw 'Active runner is not v3.6'}; $hash=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $runner -Algorithm SHA256).Hash; Write-Host ('V36_SHA256='+$hash); if($hash -ne $expected){throw 'v3.6 hash mismatch'}; $tokens=$null;$errors=$null;$ast=[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($runner,[ref]$tokens,[ref]$errors); Write-Host ('V36_SYNTAX_ERROR_COUNT='+@($errors).Count); if(@($errors).Count -ne 0){throw 'v3.6 syntax invalid'}; $funcs=@($ast.FindAll({param($n) $n -is [System.Management.Automation.Language.FunctionDefinitionAst]},$true)); $save=@($funcs|Where-Object{$_.Name -eq 'Save-State'}); Write-Host ('SAVE_STATE_FUNCTION_COUNT='+$save.Count); if($save.Count -lt 1){throw 'Save-State function missing'}; $source=Get-Content -LiteralPath $runner -Raw; $hasLast=($source -match 'lastTerminalStatus'); $hasRejected=($source -match 'REJECTED'); $hasFailed=($source -match 'FAILED_'); $hasSuccess=($source -match 'SUCCESS'); Write-Host ('HAS_LAST_TERMINAL_STATUS='+$hasLast); Write-Host ('HAS_REJECTED_TOKEN='+$hasRejected); Write-Host ('HAS_FAILED_TOKEN='+$hasFailed); Write-Host ('HAS_SUCCESS_TOKEN='+$hasSuccess); if(-not($hasLast -and $hasRejected -and $hasFailed -and $hasSuccess)){throw 'Terminal-state implementation markers incomplete'}; Write-Host '=== ISOLATED STATE HARNESS ==='; $work=$root+'/selftest/027'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $work|Out-Null; $tmpState=$work+'/state.json'; $cases=@(@{id='SELFTEST-SUCCESS';status='SUCCESS'},@{id='SELFTEST-FAILED-SCRIPT';status='FAILED_SCRIPT'},@{id='SELFTEST-FAILED-TEST';status='FAILED_TEST'},@{id='SELFTEST-REJECTED';status='REJECTED'}); $caseResults=New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]; foreach($c in $cases){$obj=[ordered]@{lastExecutedId=$c.id;lastTerminalStatus=$c.status;timestamp=(Get-Date).ToString('o')}; $json=$obj|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4; Set-Content -LiteralPath $tmpState -Encoding UTF8 -Value $json; $round=Get-Content -LiteralPath $tmpState -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json; $ok=($round.lastExecutedId -eq $c.id -and $round.lastTerminalStatus -eq $c.status); Write-Host ('CASE_'+$c.status+'='+$ok); if(-not $ok){throw ('Isolated state round-trip failed for '+$c.status)}; [void]$caseResults.Add($c.status+'=PASS')}; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tmpState -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host '=== CONCLUSION ==='; Write-Host 'SOURCE_TERMINAL_STATE_MODEL=PASS'; Write-Host 'ISOLATED_TERMINAL_STATE_ROUNDTRIP=PASS'; $reportLines=New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]; [void]$reportLines.Add('CURRENT_PID='+$PID); [void]$reportLines.Add('V36_SHA256='+$hash); [void]$reportLines.Add('SAVE_STATE_FUNCTION_COUNT='+$save.Count); [void]$reportLines.Add('SOURCE_TERMINAL_STATE_MODEL=PASS'); [void]$reportLines.Add('ISOLATED_TERMINAL_STATE_ROUNDTRIP=PASS'); foreach($line in $caseResults){[void]$reportLines.Add($line)}; Add-Content -LiteralPath $report -Encoding UTF8 -Value $reportLines.ToArray(); Write-Host '=== ONE LOGICAL CHANGE: ARM POST-FINALIZE VERIFIER ==='; $verifier=$root+'/verify-027-finalize.ps1'; $lines=[string[]]@('$ErrorActionPreference=''Continue''','$root=''C:/3EN-Agent''','$stateFile=$root+''/3en-agent.state.json''','$logFile=$root+''/3en-agent.log''','$report=$root+''/chapter-027-postfinalize.txt''','Set-Content -LiteralPath $report -Encoding UTF8 -Value ''=== CHAPTER 027 POST-FINALIZE VERIFY ===''','$deadline=(Get-Date).AddSeconds(75)','$seen=$false','while((Get-Date)-lt $deadline){try{if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $stateFile){$s=Get-Content -LiteralPath $stateFile -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($s.lastExecutedId -eq ''2026-09-09-027''){$seen=$true;Add-Content -LiteralPath $report -Value (''STATE_ID=2026-09-09-027 STATUS=''+$s.lastTerminalStatus);break}}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Seconds 2}','if(-not $seen){Add-Content -LiteralPath $report -Value ''POSTFINALIZE_RESULT=FAIL_STATE_NOT_SEEN'';exit 27}','Start-Sleep -Seconds 20','$tail=''''','if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $logFile){$tail=(Get-Content -LiteralPath $logFile -Tail 80|Out-String)}','$noNew=([regex]::Matches($tail,''No new task. ID=2026-09-09-027'')).Count','Add-Content -LiteralPath $report -Value (''NO_NEW_027_COUNT_TAIL=''+$noNew)','if($noNew -ge 1){Add-Content -LiteralPath $report -Value ''POSTFINALIZE_RESULT=PASS_NO_RETRY'';exit 0}else{Add-Content -LiteralPath $report -Value ''POSTFINALIZE_RESULT=FAIL_NO_NO-NEW_MARKER'';exit 28}'); Set-Content -LiteralPath $verifier -Encoding UTF8 -Value $lines; $vt=$null;$ve=$null;[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($verifier,[ref]$vt,[ref]$ve)|Out-Null; Write-Host ('VERIFIER_SYNTAX_ERROR_COUNT='+@($ve).Count); if(@($ve).Count -ne 0){throw 'post-finalize verifier syntax invalid'}; $vp=Start-Process -FilePath 'powershell.exe' -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',$verifier) -PassThru; Write-Host ('POSTFINALIZE_VERIFIER_PID='+$vp.Id); Write-Host 'POSTFINALIZE_VERIFIER_ARMED=TRUE'
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root='C:/3EN-Agent'; $report=$root+'/chapter-027-v36-validation.txt'; if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $report)){throw 'validation report missing'}; $txt=Get-Content -LiteralPath $report -Raw; foreach($marker in @('SOURCE_TERMINAL_STATE_MODEL=PASS','ISOLATED_TERMINAL_STATE_ROUNDTRIP=PASS','SUCCESS=PASS','FAILED_SCRIPT=PASS','FAILED_TEST=PASS','REJECTED=PASS')){if($txt -notmatch [regex]::Escape($marker)){throw ('missing marker '+$marker)}}; $verifier=$root+'/verify-027-finalize.ps1'; if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $verifier)){throw 'post-finalize verifier missing'}; $proc=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction Stop|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -like '*verify-027-finalize.ps1*'}); Write-Host ('POSTFINALIZE_VERIFIER_PROCESS_COUNT='+$proc.Count); if($proc.Count -lt 1){throw 'post-finalize verifier not running'}; Write-Host 'CHAPTER_027_PRE_FINALIZE_VALIDATION=PASS'; Write-Host 'LIVE_V36_PLUS_ISOLATED_TERMINAL_STATE_TESTS=PASS'
rollback: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; Write-Host 'Validation chapter only. Production runner/state are not modified except normal task finalization by v3.6. Backup is under C:/3EN-Agent/backups/027.'
